                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • କାରଣ (R): PM2.5 କଣିକା ଫୁସଫୁସର ଗଭୀରତାକୁ ପ୍ରବେଶ କରି ରକ୍ତପ୍ରବାହରେ ପ୍ରବେଶ କରିପାରେ - ଏହି ବିବୃତ୍ତି ମଧ୍ୟ ସଠିକ୍ | ସେମାନଙ୍କର ସୂକ୍ଷ୍ମ ଆକାର (2.5 ମାଇକ୍ରୋମିଟରରୁ କମ୍) ହେତୁ, PM2.5 କଣିକା ଶରୀରର ନାକ ଏବଂ ଗଳାରେ ଥିବା ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ ପ୍ରତିରକ୍ଷା ପ୍ରଣାଳୀକୁ ସହଜରେ ବାଇପାସ୍ କରି ଫୁସଫୁସରେ ଥିବା ଆଲଭିଓଲିରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିପାରେ ଏବଂ ରକ୍ତପ୍ରବାହରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ପ୍ରବେଶ କରିପାରେ |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ଯେହେତୁ PM2.5 କଣିକା PM10 ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଅଧିକ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟଗତ ବିପଦ କାହିଁକି ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ, R ସଠିକ୍ ଭାବରେ A କୁ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା କରେ | ତେଣୁ, ସଠିକ୍ ଉତ୍ତର ହେଉଛି A ଏବଂ R ଉଭୟ ସତ, ଏବଂ R, A କୁ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା କରେ |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ସୂଚନା

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • PM2.5 ଏବଂ PM10 କଣିକା କ’ଣ?\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • PM2.5: ପାର୍ଟିକ୍ୟୁଲେଟ୍ ମ୍ୟାଟର 2.5 2.5 ମାଇକ୍ରୋମିଟର କିମ୍ବା ଛୋଟ ବ୍ୟାସ ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ ସୂକ୍ଷ୍ମ କଣିକାକୁ ବୁଝାଏ | ଏହି କଣିକାଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଦହନ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ଦ୍ୱାରା ଉତ୍ପନ୍ନ ହୁଏ, ଯଥା ଯାନ ନିର୍ଗମନ, ଶିଳ୍ପ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପ, ଏବଂ ଜୈବ ବସ୍ତୁ ଜାଳିବା |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • PM10: ପାର୍ଟିକ୍ୟୁଲେଟ୍ ମ୍ୟାଟର 10 10 ମାଇକ୍ରୋମିଟର କିମ୍ବା ଛୋଟ ବ୍ୟାସ ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ କଣିକାକୁ ବୁଝାଏ | ଏହି କଣିକାଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ବଡ଼ ହୋଇଥାଏ ଏବଂ ନିର୍ମାଣ ଧୂଳି, ରାସ୍ତା ଧୂଳି, ଏବଂ କୃଷି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପ ପରି ଉତ୍ସରୁ ଆସିଥାଏ |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • PM2.5 ଏବଂ PM10 ର ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟଗତ ବିପଦ:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • PM2.5: ଏହି କଣିକାଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଫୁସଫୁସର ଗଭୀରତାକୁ ପ୍ରବେଶ କରି ଆଲଭିଓଲିରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିପାରନ୍ତି | ସେମାନେ ରକ୍ତପ୍ରବାହରେ ପ୍ରବେଶ କରି ହୃଦ୍ ରୋଗ, ଶ୍ୱାସକ୍ରିୟା ଜନିତ ରୋଗ, ଏବଂ ଏପରିକି କର୍କଟ ପରି ଗମ୍ଭୀର ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ସମସ୍ୟା ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିପାରନ୍ତି |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • PM10: ଏହି କଣିକାଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବଡ଼ ଏବଂ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ଉପର ଶ୍ୱାସନଳୀରେ ଫସି ରହିଥାନ୍ତି | ସେମାନେ ଆଖି, ନାକ ଏବଂ ଗଳାରେ ଉତ୍ତେଜନା ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିପାରନ୍ତି, ଏବଂ ଆଜ୍ମା ଏବଂ ବ୍ରୋଙ୍କାଇଟିସ୍ ଲକ୍ଷଣକୁ ବଢାଇପାରନ୍ତି |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • PM2.5 ଏବଂ PM10 ର ଉତ୍ସ:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • PM2.5: ଉତ୍ସଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ଯାନ ନିର୍ଗମନ, ଶିଳ୍ପ ନିର୍ଗମନ, ଜଙ୍ଗଲ ନିଆଁ, ଏବଂ କାଠ କିମ୍ବା କୋଇଲା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ଆବାସିକ ଉତ୍ତାପ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • PM10: ଉତ୍ସଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ରାସ୍ତା ଧୂଳି, ନିର୍ମାଣ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପ, କୃଷି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ, ଏବଂ ପରାଗ ଏବଂ ଛାଞ୍ଚ ସ୍ପୋର ପରି ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ ଉତ୍ସ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବିନ୍ଦୁ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • PM2.5 ଏବଂ PM10 ପାଇଁ ବିଶ୍ୱସ୍ତରୀୟ ମାନକ:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • ବିଶ୍ୱ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ସଂଗଠନ (WHO) ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, PM2.5 ପାଇଁ ବାର୍ଷିକ ହାରାହାରି 5 µg/m³, ଯେତେବେଳେ PM10 ପାଇଁ ଏହା 15 µg/m³ |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • ଭାରତରେ, PM2.5 (ବାର୍ଷିକ ହାରାହାରି) ପାଇଁ ଅନୁମତିପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ସୀମା 40 µg/m³, ଏବଂ PM10 ପାଇଁ ଏହା 60 µg/m³, ଯାହା ଜାତୀୟ ଆମ୍ବିଏଣ୍ଟ୍ ଏୟାର୍ କ୍ୱାଲିଟି ଷ୍ଟାଣ୍ଡାର୍ଡସ୍ (NAAQS) ଅନୁଯାୟୀ |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ଶମନ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରିକ୍ ଯାନ ଏବଂ ସାଧାରଣ ପରିବହନକୁ ପ୍ରୋତ୍ସାହିତ କରି ଯାନରୁ ନିର୍ଗମନ ହ୍ରାସ କରିବା |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • ନିର୍ଗମନ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ କରିବା ପାଇଁ କଠୋର ଶିଳ୍ପ ନିୟମାବଳୀ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀ କରିବା |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • କୃଷି ଅଳିଆ ପୋଡ଼ିବା ହ୍ରାସ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ସ୍ଥାୟୀ କୃଷି ପ୍ରଣାଳୀକୁ ପ୍ରୋତ୍ସାହିତ କରିବା |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n182:T2076,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਸਹੀ ਉੱਤਰ ਹੈ A ਅਤੇ R ਦੋਵੇਂ ਸੱਚ ਹਨ, ਅਤੇ R, A ਦੀ ਵਿਆਖਿਆ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਮੁੱਖ ਨੁਕਤੇ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ਦਾਅਵਾ (A): PM2.5 ਕਣ PM10 ਨਾਲੋਂ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਸਿਹਤ ਜੋਖਮ ਪੈਦਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ - ਇਹ ਕਥਨ ਸਹੀ ਹੈ। PM2.5 ਕਣ PM10 ਕਣਾਂ ਦੇ ਮੁਕਾਬਲੇ ਆਕਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਛੋਟੇ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਜਿਸ ਕਾਰਨ ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖੀ ਸਿਹਤ ਲਈ ਵਧੇਰੇ ਖਤਰਨਾਕ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਛੋਟਾ ਆਕਾਰ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਲੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਡੂੰਘਾਈ ਤੱਕ ਦਾਖਲ ਹੋਣ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ਕਾਰਨ (R): PM2.5 ਕਣ ਫੇਫੜਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਡੂੰਘਾਈ ਤੱਕ ਦਾਖਲ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਖੂਨ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਾਖਲ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ - ਇਹ ਕਥਨ ਵੀ ਸਹੀ ਹੈ। ਆਪਣੇ ਬਾਰੀਕ ਆਕਾਰ (2.5 ਮਾਈਕ੍ਰੋਮੀਟਰ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ) ਦੇ ਕਾਰਨ, PM2.5 ਕਣ ਨੱਕ ਅਤੇ ਗਲੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਰੀਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਲੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਸਾਨੀ ਨਾਲ ਬਾਈਪਾਸ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ, ਫੇਫੜਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਐਲਵੀਓਲੀ ਤੱਕ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਖੂਨ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਦਾਖਲ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਕਾਰਨ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ PM2.5 ਕਣ PM10 ਨਾਲੋਂ ਵਧੇਰੇ ਸਿਹਤ ਜੋਖਮ ਕਿਉਂ ਪੈਦਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ, R, A ਦੀ ਸਹੀ ਵਿਆਖਿਆ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਲਈ, ਸਹੀ ਉੱਤਰ ਹੈ A ਅਤੇ R ਦੋਵੇਂ ਸੱਚ ਹਨ, ਅਤੇ R, A ਦੀ ਵਿਆਖਿਆ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Corbett National Park, located in the state of Uttarakhand, India, is renowned for its dense tiger population and is part of the Project Tiger initiative. It recorded a tiger population exceeding 150 in 2024.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Corbett National Park is India's oldest national park, established in 1936.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • As per reports from the National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) and wildlife surveys, Corbett consistently ranks among the top parks with the highest tiger density, making it a prime conservation area.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     • Other Options: While parks like Ranthambore, Satpura, and Nagarhole are also known for their tiger populations, their numbers have not exceeded 150 as recorded in 2024.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The distinction of exceeding a tiger population of 150 highlights Corbett's success in tiger conservation through stringent measures such as anti-poaching strategies, habitat restoration, and scientific monitoring.Hence, the statement about Corbett is correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Corbett National Park:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Located in the Ramnagar area of Uttarakhand, Corbett covers an area of 1,318 square kilometers. It is a mix of forests, rivers, and grasslands, providing an ideal habitat for tigers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Corbett is part of the Terai Arc Landscape, which supports several threatened species, including tigers, elephants, and leopards.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The park is divided into multiple zones, such as the Dhikala Zone, Bijrani Zone, and Jhirna Zone, which are popular for tiger sightings.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Project Tiger:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Initiated in 1973, Project Tiger is a conservation program aimed at protecting tigers and their habitats across India. Corbett was among the first parks selected for this program.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The success of Project Tiger at Corbett has contributed significantly to the park's tiger population, making it a role model for other reserves.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Other National Parks:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ranthambore National Park: Located in Rajasthan, it is famous for its tiger population and historical fort. However, its tiger population has not exceeded 150.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Satpura National Park: Situated in Madhya Pradesh, it is known for diverse wildlife but has a relatively smaller tiger population compared to Corbett.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Nagarhole National Park: Located in Karnataka, it is part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve. While it has a healthy tiger population, it has not surpassed 150 tigers as per 2024 records.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Important Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Conservation Efforts:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Corbett employs advanced measures such as camera trapping, GPS tracking, and regular surveys to monitor the tiger population.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Anti-poaching patrols and community engagement programs ensure the protection of tigers and their habitats.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Tiger Population Statistics:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • India is home to 70% of the world's tiger population. As per the 2022 Tiger Census, the population of tigers in India was recorded at 3,167.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Corbett National Park leads with the highest tiger density, followed by reserves like Bandhavgarh and Ranthambore.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    सही उत्तर कॉर्बेट है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    मुख्य बिंदु

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • कॉर्बेट नेशनल पार्क, जो उत्तराखंड, भारत राज्य में स्थित है, अपनी घनी बाघ आबादी के लिए प्रसिद्ध है और प्रोजेक्ट टाइगर पहल का हिस्सा है। इसने 2024 में 150 से अधिक बाघों की आबादी दर्ज की।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • कॉर्बेट नेशनल पार्क भारत का सबसे पुराना राष्ट्रीय उद्यान है, जिसकी स्थापना 1936 में हुई थी। इसे मूल रूप से हेली नेशनल पार्क नाम दिया गया था और बाद में प्रकृतिवादी जिम कॉर्बेट के नाम पर इसका नाम बदल दिया गया।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • राष्ट्रीय बाघ संरक्षण प्राधिकरण (NTCA) और वन्यजीव सर्वेक्षणों की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, कॉर्बेट लगातार सबसे अधिक बाघ घनत्व वाले शीर्ष पार्कों में से एक है, जो इसे एक प्रमुख संरक्षण क्षेत्र बनाता है। इसलिए, कॉर्बेट नेशनल पार्क सही उत्तर है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • अन्य विकल्प: जबकि रणथंभौर, सतपुड़ा और नागरहोल जैसे पार्क भी अपनी बाघ आबादी के लिए जाने जाते हैं, लेकिन 2024 में दर्ज की गई संख्या के अनुसार इनकी संख्या 150 से अधिक नहीं है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 150 से अधिक बाघों की आबादी को पार करने का गौरव कॉर्बेट की बाघ संरक्षण में सफलता को उजागर करता है, जो शिकार-रोधी रणनीतियों, आवास बहाली और वैज्ञानिक निगरानी जैसे सख्त उपायों के माध्यम से प्राप्त हुई है।इसलिए, कॉर्बेट के बारे में कथन सही है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    अतिरिक्त जानकारी

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • कॉर्बेट नेशनल पार्क:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • उत्तराखंड के रामनगर क्षेत्र में स्थित, कॉर्बेट 1,318 वर्ग किलोमीटर के क्षेत्र में फैला हुआ है। यह जंगलों, नदियों और घास के मैदानों का मिश्रण है, जो बाघों के लिए एक आदर्श आवास प्रदान करता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
