                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ନୂତନ SP = MP ର 70%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ନୂତନ SP = 0.7 x 3125

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ନୂତନ SP = 2187.5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ 30% ରିହାତିରେ ବିକ୍ରୟ ମୂଲ୍ୟ ହେଉଛି ₹2187.50।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਛੋਟ = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਲਾਭ = 25%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਲਾਭ ਦੀ ਰਕਮ = ₹500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਫਾਰਮੂਲਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਲਾਭ = SP − CP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਲਾਭ % = (ਲਾਭ ÷ CP) x 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਵੇਚ ਮੁੱਲ = ਅੰਕਿਤ ਮੁੱਲ − ਛੋਟ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਗਣਨਾਵਾਂ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    CP ਦਾ 25% = 500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ CP = 500 x 100 ÷ 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ CP = 2000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    25% ਲਾਭ 'ਤੇ ਵੇਚ ਮੁੱਲ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ SP = CP + ਲਾਭ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ SP = 2000 + 500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ SP = 2500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਦਿੱਤੀ ਗਈ 20% ਛੋਟ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ SP = ਅੰਕਿਤ ਮੁੱਲ ਦਾ 80%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 0.8 x MP = 2500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ MP = 2500 ÷ 0.8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ MP = 3125

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਹੁਣ ਛੋਟ = 30%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ਨਵਾਂ SP = MP ਦਾ 70%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ਨਵਾਂ SP = 0.7 x 3125

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ਨਵਾਂ SP = 2187.5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ 30% ਛੋਟ 'ਤੇ ਵੇਚ ਮੁੱਲ ₹2187.50 ਹੈ।

A வேலையை முடிக்க எத்தனை நாட்கள் ஆகும்?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "12"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "20"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "16"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "18"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "or": {"value": "A ଗୋଟିଏ କାମ 24 ଦିନରେ କରିପାରେ, B 36 ଦିନରେ ଏବଂ C 72 ଦିନରେ କରିପାରେ। A ପ୍ରତିଦିନ କାମ କରେ, ଯେତେବେଳେ B ଏବଂ C ପ୍ରତି ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଦିନରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରନ୍ତି। A କାମ ସମାପ୍ତ କରିବାକୁ କେତେ ଦିନ ନେବ?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "12"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "20"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "16"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "18"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "pa": {"value": "A ਇੱਕ ਕੰਮ 24 ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, B 36 ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਤੇ C 72 ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ। A ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਦੋਂ ਕਿ B ਅਤੇ C ਹਰ ਚੌਥੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਹਾਇਤਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ। A ਨੂੰ ਕੰਮ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਦਿਨ ਲੱਗਣਗੇ?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "12"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "20"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "16"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "18"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A can do the work in 24 days

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    B can do the work in 36 days

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    C can do the work in 72 days

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A works every day

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    B and C work every 4th day

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Formula used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Work = LCM of days taken

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Total time = Total work ÷ Average work per day

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    LCM of 24, 36 and 72 = 72

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ Total work = 72 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A’s 1 day work = 72 ÷ 24 = 3 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    B’s 1 day work = 72 ÷ 36 = 2 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    C’s 1 day work = 72 ÷ 72 = 1 unit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    In 4 days:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A works for 4 days = 4 × 3 = 12 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    B and C work for 1 day = 2 + 1 = 3 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Total work in 4 days = 12 + 3 = 15 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    In 4 days → 15 units work

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    After 4 cycles (16 days):

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ Work done = 15 × 4 = 60 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Remaining work = 72 − 60 = 12 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A alone does 3 units per day

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Days to finish remaining work = 12 ÷ 3 = 4 days

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Total days = 16 + 4 = 20 days

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ A will take 20 days to complete the work.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A एक कार्य को 24 दिनों में कर सकता है

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    B एक कार्य को 36 दिनों में कर सकता है

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    C एक कार्य को 72 दिनों में कर सकता है
