                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ বৃত্তকলার", "bn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    বৃত্তের ব্যাসার্ধ (r) = 14 সেমি

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ বৃত্তকলার ক্ষেত্রফল = (60 ÷ 360) × π × 142

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ বৃত্তকলার ক্ষেত্রফল = (1 ÷ 6) × π × 196

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ বৃত্তকলার ক্ষেত্রফল = 98π ÷ 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ত্রিভুজের ক্ষেত্রফল = 1/2 × 14 × 14 × sin60°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ত্রিভুজের ক্ষেত্রফল = 49√3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ক্ষুদ্র অংশের ক্ষেত্রফল = (98π ÷ 3) − 49√3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ વૃત્તાંશનું ક્ષેત્રફળ = 98π ÷ 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ લઘુ વૃત્તખંડનું ક્ષેત્રફળ = (98π ÷ 3) − 49√3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ લઘુ વૃત્તખંડનું ક્ષેત્રફળ = (98π/3 − 49√3) સેમી2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    கொடுக்கப்பட்டவை:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ସୂତ୍ର:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ବୃତ୍ତାଂଶର କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ = (θ ÷ 360) x π x r2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ତ୍ରିଭୁଜର କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ = 1/2 x r x r x sinθ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    କ୍ଷୁଦ୍ର ବୃତ୍ତାଂଶର କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ = ବୃତ୍ତାଂଶର କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ − ତ୍ରିଭୁଜର କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ଗଣନା:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ବୃତ୍ତାଂଶର କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ = (60 ÷ 360) x π x 142

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ବୃତ୍ତାଂଶର କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ = (1 ÷ 6) x π x 196

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ବୃତ୍ତାଂଶର କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ = 98π ÷ 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ତ୍ରିଭୁଜର କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ = 1/2 x 14 x 14 x sin60°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ତ୍ରିଭୁଜର କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ = 98 x (√3 ÷ 2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ ତ୍ରିଭୁଜର କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ = 49√3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ କ୍ଷୁଦ୍ର ବୃତ୍ତାଂଶର କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ = (98π ÷ 3) − 49√3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ କ୍ଷୁଦ୍ର ବୃତ୍ତାଂଶର କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ = (98π/3 − 49√3) cm2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The word \"Loquacious\" means someone who tends to talk a lot or is very talkative. (बातूनी)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: She is so loquacious that she can hold a conversation for hours without pausing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \"Talkative\" refers to a person who enjoys talking and speaks freely and frequently. (बातूनी)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: The talkative child kept sharing stories with everyone at the party.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Hence, we can infer that the synonym of 'Loquacious' is 'Talkative'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Therefore, the correct answer is: Talkative.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Quiet (शांत): Refers to someone who is silent or speaks very little.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: The quiet room was perfect for studying without interruptions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Reserved (संकोची): Refers to someone who is introverted and keeps to themselves.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: Despite being reserved, he opened up once he got to know the group.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
