                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The correct answer is: Abyss.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The word "Abyss" refers to a vast, deep void with no visible bottom or an immeasurably deep chasm. (गहरी खाई)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Example: The explorers stood at the edge of the abyss, staring into the darkness below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • An abyss is often used figuratively to describe a situation of great depth or complexity, such as moral dilemmas or emotional struggles. (गहराई)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Example: She felt like she was falling into an emotional abyss after the tragic loss.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Therefore, the correct answer is: Abyss.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Crevice (दरार): A narrow crack or opening, especially in a rock or wall.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Example: The small lizard disappeared into the crevice of the rock.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Crater (गड्ढा): A large, bowl-shaped cavity formed by an explosion or impact, often seen on the surface of planets.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Example: The meteor left a massive crater in the desert.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ravine (गहरी घाटी): A deep, narrow gorge or valley, often with a river flowing through it.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Example: The hikers cautiously crossed the ravine using the wooden bridge.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The word \"arrive at\" means to reach a decision, conclusion, or understanding about something.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Draw out (निकालना): To encourage someone to reveal or explain more about their thoughts or feelings.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Example: The teacher tried to draw out the shy student by asking open-ended questions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Bring up (उठाना): To mention or introduce a topic in conversation.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Example: She decided to bring up the issue of pay during the meeting.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Make over (बदलाव करना): To change or improve something, often referring to appearance or style.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Example: The interior designer made over the living room to give it a modern look.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
