                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The correct answer is 'Option 3'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A) According to the passage, when freedom is exercised without responsibility, it can lead to misuse and societal damage.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The text mentions that freedoms exercised without restraint can foster disorder, social division, and even authoritarian reactions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • B) "Strengthens legal systems" is incorrect because irresponsible use of freedom does not reinforce legal frameworks.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Instead, it undermines the very foundations of democratic governance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • C) "Promotes unity" is incorrect as the passage states that irresponsible freedom can lead to social division.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Unity is achieved through responsible exercise of freedoms, not their misuse.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • D) "Ensures better governance" is incorrect because the passage suggests that freedom without responsibility can jeopardize public order and governance.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Better governance is tied to the responsible exercise of freedoms and civic duties.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3: It results in misuse and societal damage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Option 1: It strengthens legal systems - Incorrect because misuse of freedom undermines legal and social frameworks.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Option 2: It promotes unity - Incorrect, as the passage notes that it leads to social division and disorder.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Option 4: It ensures better governance - Incorrect since responsible exercise of freedom is essential for good governance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ", "hn": "", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Verbal Ability"], "concept": "Verbal Ability", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "69454f95194ac23122bb6454", "qs_no": 19, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "Why does the author cite protests and voting as examples?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "To criticise civic engagement"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "To illustrate the balance between freedom and responsibility"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "To advocate stricter laws"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "To justify authoritarian control"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The correct answer is 'Option 2'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A) The author cites protests and voting as examples to illustrate the balance between freedom and responsibility.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The passage emphasizes that rights such as protest and expression must be exercised responsibly to maintain public order and factual integrity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • B) "Criticise civic engagement" is incorrect because the passage does not condemn participation in civic activities such as protests and voting.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Rather, it stresses the importance of responsible civic engagement to uphold democratic values.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • C) "Advocate stricter laws" is incorrect as the passage does not call for stricter laws, but instead for responsible exercise of freedoms within the existing legal framework.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The focus is on accountability and ethical judgment rather than the imposition of more laws.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • D) "Justify authoritarian control" is incorrect because the author warns against misuse that could lead to authoritarian reactions, not advocating for authoritarianism itself.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The passage highlights the need for a balance to prevent such extremes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2: To illustrate the balance between freedom and responsibility.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Option 1: To criticise civic engagement - Incorrect because the passage supports responsible engagement, not criticism of it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Option 3: To advocate stricter laws - Incorrect as the passage calls for responsibility rather than more laws.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Option 4: To justify authoritarian control - Incorrect because the passage warns against misuse that may lead to authoritarian control, not justifies it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
