                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The correct answer is 'Option 3'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A) The passage implies that democratic institutions rely on active citizen participation.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The text notes that democracy depends on responsible citizens who actively preserve its values, indicating the importance of civic engagement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • B) "They function independently of citizens" is incorrect because the passage emphasizes the role of citizens in maintaining democratic values.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The passage argues that freedoms must be exercised responsibly by citizens, which shows their integral role in the process.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • C) "They preserve themselves automatically" is incorrect, as the passage clearly states that democracy relies on both legal structures and responsible citizens.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • This highlights the necessity of active participation and responsibility from the citizens.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • D) "They must restrict civil rights" is incorrect because the passage talks about balancing freedoms with responsibility, not restricting them.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The focus is on responsible exercise of freedoms, not on the restriction of rights.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3: They rely on active citizen participation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Option 1: They function independently of citizens - Incorrect as the passage emphasizes the interconnectedness of citizens and democratic institutions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Option 2: They preserve themselves automatically - Incorrect because the preservation of democracy requires active effort from responsible citizens.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Option 4: They must restrict civil rights - Incorrect since the passage advocates for a balance of rights and responsibilities rather than restrictions on rights.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The correct answer is 'Option 3'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A) The passage portrays crises in democratic societies as exposure of risks of unchecked liberty.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The text states that in times of crisis, such as health emergencies or civil unrest, the misuse of freedom can endanger collective well-being, highlighting the risks of exercising freedoms without responsibility.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • B) "Validation of unlimited freedom" is incorrect, as the passage emphasizes that freedoms without restraint can lead to negative outcomes.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • It underlines the need for balancing freedoms with responsibilities.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • C) "Justification for total state control" is incorrect because the passage warns against authoritarian reactions rather than justifying them.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • It stresses the importance of responsible exercise of freedoms to avoid such extremes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • D) "Diminishing the importance of rights" is incorrect, as the passage considers rights important but insists on their responsible use.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • It calls for a balance between rights and responsibilities, not diminishing the importance of rights.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3: As exposure of risks of unchecked liberty.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Option 1: As validation of unlimited freedom - Incorrect because the passage stresses the dangers of unrestricted liberties.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Option 2: As justification for total state control - Incorrect as the passage warns against authoritarian reactions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Option 4: As diminishing the importance of rights - Incorrect since the passage emphasizes the need for responsible rights use rather than reducing their importance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
