                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A) The author's tone on democratic freedom is best described as balanced and cautionary.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The passage acknowledges the importance of democratic freedoms while emphasizing the need for responsibility and caution to prevent negative outcomes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • B) "Sarcastic" is incorrect, as the author does not use irony or mockery.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The tone is serious and focused on the balance between freedom and responsibility.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • C) "Detached" is incorrect, as the author actively engages with the topic, providing a thorough examination of the need for responsibility in exercising democratic freedoms.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The author is clearly concerned about the implications of misuse.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • D) "Excessively optimistic" is incorrect because the author highlights potential dangers and the need for caution, rather than presenting an overly positive view.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The author's approach is realistic and balanced, not excessively optimistic.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2: Balanced and cautionary.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A sentence is given in direct speech. Choose the most accurate indirect form:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                He said, “I am reading a book.”

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The correct answer is Option 2.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Indirect Speech: He said that he was reading a book.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Key Conversions:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • "I am reading" becomes "he was reading"\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Pronoun "I" is converted to "he" based on the subject of the reporting verb.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Present continuous tense "am reading" is converted to past continuous tense "was reading" as the reporting verb "said" is in the past tense.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Punctuation and Format:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The conjunction "that" is added in indirect speech.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Correct Sentence: He said that he was reading a book.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Option 1: "He said he is reading a book."\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Incorrect tense: "is reading" (present continuous) is not changed to "was reading" (past continuous).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Option 3: "He said that he had read a book."\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Incorrect tense: "had read" (past perfect) changes the meaning of the original sentence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Option 4: "He said he read a book."\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Incorrect tense: "read" (simple past) is not appropriate as it does not represent the continuous action of "reading."
